summary: Iteration 5 verifies the three new features: Progress Export/Report, User Management, and Site Photos on Plan. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with three new test classes (TestReports, TestUserManagement, TestPins). Full run = 52 passed / 2 skipped (milestones intentionally empty). Key coverage: (a) GET /api/reports/summary returns overall{total>=80} + per-building trades rows; GET /api/reports/detail returns >=80 items each with done_steps/outstanding_steps/photos/drawings; GET /api/reports/excel serves text/csv with correct header + >=81 rows via cookie auth and returns 401 without auth. (b) Admin-gating verified: GET /api/users no-auth => 401; trade token => 403; admin sees full list without _id or password_hash leak. POST /api/users creates a user (email/password/name/role/company) with password_hash, and the newly created user can log in via POST /api/auth/login. PATCH /api/users/{id} grants and revokes admin (role flips affect subsequent /api/users access for that user). DELETE /api/users/{id} removes the user (and 400 for self-delete). Duplicate email create => 400. (c) GET /api/documents/{id}/page renders PDF first page as PNG (>200 bytes) via cookie auth and 401 without. POST /api/pins with multipart photo saves photo_path (stored under {app}/pins/) and returns pin doc; GET /api/pins?location_id lists pins; pin without photo also works; DELETE /api/pins/{id} removes it. /api/pins requires auth. Frontend Playwright: admin login auto-lands on dashboard; nav-report + nav-users visible; Progress Report renders 82 report-item rows with excel + print PDF buttons; User Management lists seed users, add-user-btn opens create-user-modal, filled it, created a real user via UI (POST /api/users), granted-admin + revoked-admin clicks fired PATCHes, and delete-user removed the row. Site Photos on Plan: opened RACF Ground Floor -> Floor Plan tab; plan-select populated and plan-image rendered from GET /api/documents/{id}/page; clicking the plan opened pin-dialog, saving created a numbered pin marker (pin-<uuid>), clicking the marker opened pin-view, pin-delete removed it. nav-users is correctly HIDDEN for the plumbing trade user (admin-only rendering via Layout.jsx filter).

minor.issue: No validation of role value - any string can be set (e.g. 'foo'). Consider whitelist ('admin','pm','trade','viewer').
No password strength check (accepts 'x'). Fine for demo, worth flagging.

(carry-over) attachment file route lacks auth enforcement wording matches pin photos too - currently JWT is verified via token/cookie/auth query, so it's actually enforced; earlier report was inaccurate.
(carry-over) env var defined but hardcoded FRONTEND_URL is used

Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to Radix Dialogs (pin-dialog, create-user-modal, pin-view) to remove console warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1144 lines - reports/pins/users/auth should be split into routers before it grows further.
POST /api/pins accepts arbitrary plan_doc_id without validating the doc belongs to the location's project - low impact but a soft check would prevent orphaned refs.
PATCH /api/users/{id} accepts role/company_id without enum validation.
seed_data still puts every company in visible_to for every visi (carry-over).

success_rate.backend: 100% (52 passed / 2 skipped - milestones empty by design)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (admin login, nav visibility, Progress Report with 82 items + Excel + Print buttons, User Management full CRUD + role toggle via UI, Site Photos on Plan drop/view/delete pin, trade user's nav-users hidden)
